t: About DXing – FM Radio DX
s: May 20, 2021 - DXing is the logging of distant signals. It is entirely possible to pick up an FM station 500-1500 miles away with rabbit ears indoors, or in a car. A DXer in Nebraska can pick up a radio station in Florida, while someone in Louisiana may hear an FM station from central America.
